conviction_note: Median print reaction is 14.86% against only 20.9% annualised realised vol, so this name is unusually print-sensitive; the corpus's one genuinely unobserved item is an activist 13D/A filed three weeks before the print into a total news blackout, which I can date and count but not read, so it earns a small positive tilt with a band far wider than the tilt.

findings.finding: The same 13D filer (CIK 0001734916) amended its Schedule 13D on 2026-08-11 at 21:21:42Z, six weeks after amending it on 2026-06-30 - an accelerating campaign cadence three weeks before the print - and not one item anywhere in the 103-item capture mentions it, the news and social flow going completely silent between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-31 while the stock drifted down 10.08% over twenty sessions.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json accession 0001734916-26-000004 (SCHEDULE 13D/A, accepted 2026-08-11T21:21:42Z); prior amendments from the same filer at accessions 0001734916-26-000003 (2026-06-30) and 0001734916-25-000005 (2025-12-12), plus a different filer's amendment 0001539497-25-002775 (2025-10-24)
findings.why_not_priced: A $19 microcap with 447k average daily volume and one covering broker gets no aggregation of its ownership filings. The corpus proves the non-coverage rather than assuming it: 100 of the 103 captured items are EDGAR index rows, there is no news document at all, and the retail message stream has no post between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-31 - i.e. nothing was said about the amendment on or after the day it was filed. If it had been priced, a name that moves a median 14.86% on prints would not have drifted quietly lower on no volume event. I sign it positive because an escalating amendment cadence at a company that has filed five separate item 5.02 8-Ks since January and whose own 10-K newly lists 'activist-driven strategic shifts' as a risk factor reads as a live campaign rather than an exit, and an exiting 5% holder typically files one final amendment and stops.
findings.independence: Two other parts of the corpus point the same way from different sources: the 10-K risk-factor diff summary at https://d-risk.ai/DAKT/10-K/2026-06-24 (docs/96e7b96f48554762ad1eebfa15bffabc5f18257e.txt, message of 2026-06-25) records 'leadership transition risk, and activist-driven strategic shifts' as newly added risk factors, and filings.json independently shows item 5.02 8-Ks on 2026-01-21, 2026-02-02, 2026-02-20, 2026-05-21 and 2026-07-17.

searched_and_found_nothing: the content or direction of the 13D/A: no body is stored and the index row gives only the filer CIK, so I cannot tell whether the stake went up, went down or the intent changed

the direction of the five-Form-4 cluster all filed 2026-08-25 between 21:07 and 21:27Z (accessions 0001628280-26-058941/58943/58945/58947/58953): no bodies, and five insiders filing within twenty minutes at a company whose annual report went out on 2026-07-28 is at least as likely to be annual director equity grants as open-market buying, so I did not score it
the content of the fresh Sidoti research note published 2026-08-31, one session before the print - it reaches the corpus only as a dlvr.it shortlink with no body
any capital-markets filing: no S-3, 424B or shelf in the 400-day index
any consensus EPS or revenue estimate for the quarter, or any preview: nothing in the capture provides one
an explanation for the -10.08% twenty-day slide: no August filing other than the 13D/A and the Form 4 cluster, and no news item at all
baseline_tension: It cuts against the run-up: the stock lost 10.1% over twenty sessions with no company news, and my read is that the one thing that did happen in that window was a filing pointing the other way.
corpus_limits: This is a bmo print, so per the sweep rule I excluded the final snapshot, snapshots/20260902T150741Z.json (started 2026-09-02T15:07:41Z, after the item 2.02 8-K was accepted at 07:44:37Z) and its stored body docs/f17cb2999c9d236e22d186825235d48dde98a1fb.txt, which I did not open. I also declined to reason from the item list of that print-day 8-K (accession 0001628280-26-059967), because its item codes disclose what was announced with the results and that is outcome information. Beyond that: no option chain or skew; no body for the 13D/A, for any of the five item 5.02 8-Ks, or for any Form 4; and no news documents whatsoever, so the entire read rests on the filing index plus one retail blob.
